tickets.subject: Authenticator recovery codes rejected after MFA recovery
tickets.description: A support agent used an old recovery code after the customer regenerated their MFA backup codes. The customer cannot complete authentication.
tickets.resolution_notes: Regenerating backup codes invalidates the old set. Verify account ownership using the approved recovery process and use an unused code from the current set. Never request a password or MFA code through a ticket.

tickets.subject: SCIM provisioning leaves renamed employee without group access
tickets.description: An identity provider renamed an employee but SCIM provisioning matched accounts by email instead of immutable external ID. The employee lost team group access.
tickets.resolution_notes: Reconcile the account using the identity provider's immutable external ID and resync group membership. Audit duplicate identities before merging accounts; email is not a stable identity key.

tickets.subject: PostgreSQL connector fails SSL certificate verification
tickets.description: The PostgreSQL source connector stopped syncing after a database certificate renewal. The certificate chain has expired and the connector reports certificate verify failed.
tickets.resolution_notes: Replace the expired intermediate certificate and configure the complete trusted certificate chain. Re-test connectivity with certificate verification enabled; do not bypass TLS verification.

tickets.subject: API rejects valid JSON payload with HTTP 415
tickets.description: A client's JSON request is rejected with unsupported media type 415 because the Content-Type header was sent as text/plain.
tickets.resolution_notes: Send Content-Type: application/json and validate the payload encoding. Return a clear unsupported-media-type error rather than accepting ambiguous request formats.

tickets.subject: VAT charged despite validated reverse-charge tax ID
tickets.description: An EU business invoice includes VAT even though a validated tax ID should qualify the purchase for reverse-charge treatment.
tickets.resolution_notes: Have billing review tax-ID validation and jurisdiction eligibility, correct the tax configuration, and issue an amended invoice if appropriate. Tax treatment requires billing review, not an automatic support promise.

tickets.subject: Webhook HMAC signature fails after JSON middleware rewrite
tickets.description: The webhook receiver validates the HMAC signature over parsed and reserialized JSON. Whitespace changes cause valid webhook signatures to fail verification.
tickets.resolution_notes: Verify the signature over the exact raw request body before JSON parsing, using the configured signing secret and constant-time comparison. Keep replay timestamp validation enabled.

tickets.subject: Dashboard cache appears to show another organization's data
tickets.description: A customer reports a possible cross-organization data leak from a shared dashboard cache entry. The incident investigation is awaiting security approval.
tickets.resolution_notes: Escalate using the security incident process. This investigation note is not an approved resolution and must not be surfaced as reusable advice.

tickets.subject: CSV spreadsheet cells interpreted as formulas
tickets.description: A spreadsheet executes exported customer-supplied cell values as formulas when a CSV is opened. The export needs formula injection protection.
tickets.resolution_notes: Neutralize formula-like cells at export according to the supported spreadsheet format, including leading whitespace/control characters. Preserve the original application value and add regression tests for spreadsheet consumers.

tickets.subject: Scheduled reports arrive one hour late after daylight saving change
tickets.description: A weekly report schedule shifted by one hour after daylight saving time changed. The scheduler stored a fixed UTC offset rather than an IANA timezone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Store the customer's IANA timezone and calculate each next run from local wall-clock time. Validate ambiguous and nonexistent times around daylight saving transitions.

tickets.subject: Pending card authorization mistaken for duplicate settled charge
tickets.description: A card statement shows one pending authorization and one settled subscription charge. The customer believes they were charged twice but the processor shows only one settled payment.
tickets.resolution_notes: Verify settlement state and processor transaction IDs before considering a refund. Explain the pending authorization release window; do not apply the historical duplicate-settlement fix without confirming two settled charges.

tickets.subject: API key authenticates but dataset read returns HTTP 403
tickets.description: A valid API key reaches the service but gets forbidden 403 when reading a restricted dataset because its scope lacks dataset:read.
tickets.resolution_notes: Ask an authorized organization admin to review the key's dataset access and grant the minimum required scope. Authentication success does not imply authorization; do not increase privileges without approval.

tickets.subject: S3 report export denied by KMS encryption key policy
tickets.description: An S3 export fails with AccessDenied even though bucket write permission is granted. The export worker lacks the required KMS encryption key permission.
tickets.resolution_notes: Review both the bucket policy and the KMS key policy for the designated export identity. Grant only the required encryption permissions and verify the intended bucket and key, without broad wildcard grants.

tickets.subject: BigQuery ingestion fails after source column rename
tickets.description: BigQuery data ingestion returns unknown column after the source team renamed a field. The connector's schema mapping still references the previous column name.
tickets.resolution_notes: Confirm the intended schema with the source owner, update the connector mapping, and validate dependent dashboards before restarting ingestion. Monitor schema changes rather than dropping unmapped fields silently.

tickets.subject: Password reset email never arrives due to suppression list
tickets.description: A user requested a password reset but the email never arrives, including in spam. The mail provider suppressed the recipient following a previous hard bounce.
tickets.resolution_notes: Verify the recipient and inspect the mail provider's delivery/suppression event. Follow the approved process to clear an incorrect suppression after fixing the address; do not disclose whether an arbitrary account exists.

tickets.subject: Safari embedded dashboard login loops because third-party cookies blocked
tickets.description: An embedded dashboard keeps redirecting to login on Safari because the browser blocks third-party session cookies in an iframe.
tickets.resolution_notes: Use the supported top-level authentication flow rather than disabling browser privacy protections. Confirm embedding and session-cookie requirements for the supported browser version.

tickets.subject: Queued export continues after user's dataset permission revoked
tickets.description: A queued report export retains a snapshot of access permissions from submission. The user's dataset permission was revoked before the export worker began processing.
tickets.resolution_notes: Recheck authorization at execution and download time, cancel unauthorized work, and expire inaccessible artifacts. Submission-time access alone is not sufficient.

tickets.subject: CSV accented names appear garbled in Excel
tickets.description: UTF-8 CSV exports containing accented names display garbled characters when opened in an older Excel configuration expecting a different encoding.
tickets.resolution_notes: Use the documented UTF-8 import option or the supported Excel-compatible export variant. Add non-ASCII encoding test cases; avoid lossy conversion of customer names.

tickets.subject: Seat-count invoice investigation awaiting finance approval
tickets.description: A seat-count invoice may include dormant accounts. Finance has not yet approved an adjustment or confirmed whether inactive seats remain billable under this plan.
tickets.resolution_notes: Await finance review. Do not reuse an unapproved credit decision.

tickets.subject: Webhook signatures rejected because receiver clock is skewed
tickets.description: Webhook signature verification rejects valid delivery timestamps as outside the replay window because the receiver clock is several minutes behind.
tickets.resolution_notes: Correct receiver time synchronization and keep the replay window bounded. Confirm delivery timestamps and signature verification without disabling replay protection.

tickets.subject: Cursor pagination repeats records while dataset changes
tickets.description: A client sees repeated records between API pages because pagination uses an unstable sort key while new records are inserted.
tickets.resolution_notes: Use a stable deterministic sort with a unique tie-breaker and a snapshot-aware cursor. Document cursor expiry and validate duplicates across page boundaries.

tickets.subject: Audit investigation into cross-organization SQL query permissions
tickets.description: An audit suspects SQL query results may cross an organization access boundary. Security is validating the incident and no resolution is approved.
tickets.resolution_notes: Follow security escalation and evidence preservation. This is not approved reusable advice.

tickets.subject: Legacy connector TLS verification workaround is deprecated
tickets.description: A legacy connector formerly bypassed TLS certificate verification as a workaround. That unsafe workaround is no longer supported.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deprecated: do not reuse certificate-verification bypasses. Replace the certificate chain using the approved connector procedure.

tickets.subject: Heatmap clipping after new browser update under investigation
tickets.description: A new browser release clips heatmap axis labels. Reproduction and root-cause investigation are still ongoing.

tickets.subject: Legacy Oracle wallet rotation connection failure
tickets.description: The legacy Oracle warehouse connector rejected a rotated wallet file. This resolution has not been reviewed against current connector versions.
tickets.resolution_notes: Historical investigation refreshed the wallet configuration. This old precedent needs version and security review before reuse.
